liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments rose by {{cash_like.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_like@FY2025}}, and total liquidity stood at {{liquidity@FY2025}}, including {{undrawn_facilities@FY2025}} of undrawn committed facilities.
Liquidity to revenue was {{liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, and cash liquidity to revenue rose by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}.
On the funding side, Fitch affirmed Aena's long-term and short-term ratings with a stable long-term outlook, and the Brazilian subsidiary BOAB issued secured debentures maturing in the long term.

operating_performance.text: In FY2024 the Spanish network carried {{passengers@FY2024}} passengers, with traffic growth of {{traffic_growth@FY2024}}.
Aeronautical revenue per passenger in the Spanish network was {{aero_revenue_per_passenger@FY2024}} in FY2024.
The CNMC set the average airport charge per passenger for 2026 above the prior year's level, which supports the aeronautical revenue base.

peer_positioning.text: Aena has the highest EBITDA margin in the airport group ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@2025}}), at {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}} against a peer median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@2025}}.
Gross leverage of {{gross_leverage@FY2025}} puts the company in the middle of the group ({{gross_leverage.peer_rank@2025}}).
It leads the group on interest coverage ({{interest_coverage.peer_rank@2025}}), FFO to debt ({{ffo_to_debt.peer_rank@2025}}) and FCF to debt ({{fcf_to_debt.peer_rank@2025}}).
Capex intensity of {{capex_intensity@FY2025}} is below the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@2025}}.

watch_items.text: Cash generation: FCF to debt of {{fcf_to_debt@FY2025}} is above the peer median of {{fcf_to_debt.peer_median@2025}}, but it fell by {{fcf_to_debt.change@FY2025}} over the year.
Investment: capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2025}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2025}}, which absorbed part of the cash generated.
Margins: the EBITDA margin eased by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}}, though it remains above the peer median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@2025}}.
Debt: total debt rose by {{total_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{total_debt@FY2025}}, so net leverage of {{net_leverage@FY2025}} depends on EBITDA holding at current levels.
